Bands not visited, 2,500. These are mainly some detached bands of Stickeen, Chilcats and some Small Jinnie Tribes,
on the head waters of the Stickeen, Chilcat, Yukon, Laird and Dease Rivers.


RECAPITULATION, B.C.
Population, 25,618; Protestants, 6,327; Roman Catholics, 9,768; Pagans, 4,869.
There are 4,651 of which the Department has no returns as to religion.
